units: <cite ref="Sotah 21a:8">Sot. 21ᵃ</cite> <he>הגיע לפ׳ דרכים וכ׳</he> when the traveller reaches the cross-road (where there is a guide-post), he is saved from all dangers.
<cite ref="Sotah 21a">Ib.</cite> <he>מהו פ׳ ד׳ וכ׳</he> what is meant by cross-road (in this parable)? A scholar on his dying day.—

<cite ref="Chullin 46a:4">Ḥull. 46ᵃ</cite> <he>פ׳ ראשונה</he> the first branching off of the spinal column towards the legs, <he>שניה</he> the second branching off in the prolongation which forms the tail.

Ib. פי פ׳ the starting point of the branching off; פ׳ עצמה the branch itself; a. e.—Pl. פָּרָשׁוֹת. Ib. 45ᵇ עד היכך חוט השדרה … עד בין הפ׳ how far does the spinal cord go (the severance of which causes the animal to be ṭ’refah)?… To ‘between the ramifications’; ליחוי לן מר בין הפ׳ show us the place called ‘between the ramifications’; a. e.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 35">Lev. R. s. 35</cite>, v. <cite ref="A02838"><he>אַפְרָשָׁה</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: (in writing) division, section, Parashah, the weekly Scripture lesson.
units: Ber. 9ᵇ אשרי … חדא פ׳ היא Ashré (Ps. I) and Lammah rag’shu (Ps. II) are one section (psalm). Ib. 63ᵃ איזוהי פ׳ קטנה שכל וכ׳ which is the small section (verse) on which all essentials of the Law depend? (Answ.

<cite ref="Proverbs 3:6">Prov. III, 6</cite>) ‘In all thy ways &c.’ Ib. II, 2 (13ᵃ) <he>למה קדמה פרשת שמע וכ׳</he> Bab. ed. (Mish. a. Y. ed. only <cite ref="U01512"><he>שמע</he></cite>) why is the section Sh’mʿa (<cite ref="Deuteronomy 6:4-9">Deut. VI, 4-9</cite>) recited before V’hayah (ib. XI, 13-21)? <cite ref="Bava Batra 14b:12">B. Bath. 14ᵇ</cite> <he>פרשת בלעם</he> the section treating of Balaam (<cite ref="Numbers 22:2">Num. XXII, 2</cite>-XXIV, 25); a. v. fr.—Pl. <he>פָּרָשִׁיּוֹת</he> (fr. <cite ref="Q02037"><he>פָּרָשׁוּת</he></cite>).

<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 1:12">Tosef. Sabb. I, 12</cite> <he>תינוקות … פָּרָשִׁיּוֹתֵיהֶן</he> children and teacher may prepare their verses by lamp-light &c.; (Y. ib. I, 3ᵇ bot. <he>ראשי פסוקיהן</he>).
<cite ref="Berakhot 8b:1">Ber. 8ᵇ</cite> <he>המשלים פָּרָשִׁיּוֹתָיו עם הצבור</he> he who finishes the reading of the weekly lessons so as to keep up with the public reading in the synagogue.
<cite ref="Megillah 29b:13">Meg. 29ᵇ</cite> <he>לסדר פ׳ הוא חוזר</he> the interrupted order of Scriptural reading is taken up again; a. v. fr.
